decision: Selected the US Census Bureau geocoder point for 1441 Rumble Road, Forsyth, GA 31029, the facility address that Georgia EPD's public advisory PA1126-1 gives for 'Rumble Road Facility' (air application 30405), as the campus locator. No official parcel geometry was reachable: www.monroecountyga.gov and the Middle Georgia Regional Commission host (www.mg-rc.org) did not answer robots.txt requests, and the qPublic/Beacon assessor front ends were not used (interactive terms and bot challenge). ArcGIS Online feature hosts answer robots.txt with HTTP 403.
conversion: Geocoder output in NAD83 geographic coordinates used as WGS84 without transformation (sub-metre difference at this scale); rounded to 7 decimals.
identity_bridge: Georgia EPD Air Protection Branch public advisory PA1126-1 (PDF created 4 November 2026; listed on EPD's advisories page as 4 November 2026; comments due 4 December 2026) lists, under MONROE COUNTY: Facility Name 'Rumble Road Facility', Application No 30405, Facility Address '1441 Rumble Road, Forsyth, 31029', EPD Notice Type 'Permit Application', Description of Operation 'Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services', Reason for Application 'Construct and operate a data center and install diesel-fired emergency generators'.

The Census geocoder matches the address (1441 RUMBLE RD, FORSYTH, GA, 31029) on TIGER/Line edge 66671750 (right side, address range 1349-1599) in Monroe County (13207), Culloden-Bolingbroke CCD, the county the EPD advisory names.
not_used: No map service, map viewport, embedded map widget, short link, directory coordinate, OpenStreetMap service, PeeringDB record, city centre or county centroid was used.
nearby_records_within_2km: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping coordinate, pending queue addition, locator correction or claim by another fragment lies within 2 km (none within 40 km).
precision_note: The point is the geocoder's interpolated position for the address along the street segment, not the facility parcel, a building or a surveyed boundary; the facility extent and its offset from the street are unknown.
